You’ll find English dictionaries at beginner, intermediate, and advanced levels, in British and American English, with clear definitions, audio pronunciations and plenty of example sentences—as well as translation dictionaries in more than 20 languages.  
 
If you’re already a registered user of Cambridge Dictionary +Plus on the website, you can use your word lists anywhere—in the app, or on your computer.  
 
ABOUT US 
Cambridge Dictionary is the world’s most popular online dictionary for learners of English. Cambridge University Press has been publishing dictionaries for learners of English since 1995. Our corpus-informed dictionaries support independent learning.
